the platelet activation and the activation of the coagulation and fibrinolysis systems were increased in the early phase of acute myocardial infection.

platelet activation and coagulation/fibinolytic activity in the acute phase were significantly higher than in normal subjects, and that the coagulation and fibrinolytic system remained activated 1 month after myocardial infarct, while platelet activation had returned to normal.

the platelet activation is a persistent and latent phenomenon, which is not easily detected in the clinical setting.
